CommandCentral DEMS

Flight evidence, filed straight into your DEMS.

Other Law Enforcement

About this integration

CommandCentral DEMS is Motorola Solutions' digital evidence management system, used by agencies to store, tag, and manage evidentiary media with chain-of-custody controls.

This integration automatically sends evidence — video, images, and flight metadata — after every Guardian flight directly into your connected CommandCentral DEMS account.

Like BRINC's other DEMS integrations, this removes the manual step of exporting and uploading drone footage, keeping your evidence trail consistent whether it came from a body camera, in-car camera, or a Guardian drone.

Available now for CommandCentral DEMS customers.
